# Redfin.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/redfin-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/redfin-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects property listing data from Redfin.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Redfin Real Estate Property Data in Python](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-redfin)
- **Code:** [`redfin.py`](redfin.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Property pages for sale](results/properties_for_sale.json) · [Property pages for rent](results/properties_for_rent.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Redfin's property search for finding property listings
- Redfin's property pages for property for rent/sale listing data

## Functions

- `scrape_search(url)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape search data from the searh API
- `scrape_property_for_sale(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape properties for sale data from HTML
- `scrape_property_for_rent(urls)` → `list[Dict]`: scrape properties for rent from the API

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import redfin


async def main():
    property_for_rent = await redfin.scrape_property_for_rent(
        urls=[
            "https://www.redfin.com/WA/Seattle/Onni-South-Lake-Union/apartment/147020546",
            "https://www.redfin.com/WA/Seattle/The-Ivey-on-Boren/apartment/146904423",
        ],
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/properties_for_sale.json`](results/properties_for_sale.json): `address`, `description`, `price`, `estimatedMonthlyPrice`, `propertyUrl`, `attachments`, `details`, `features`
- [`results/properties_for_rent.json`](results/properties_for_rent.json): `rentalId`, `unitTypesByBedroom`, `totalUnitTypes`, `totalUnits`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `mlsId`, `showMlsId`, `mlsStatus`, `showDatasourceLogo`, `price`, `hideSalePrice`, `hoa`, `isHoaFrequencyKnown`, `sqFt`, `pricePerSqFt`, `lotSize`, `beds`, `baths`, `fullBaths`, `location`, `stories`, `latLong`, `streetLine`, `unitNumber`, `city`, `state`, `zip`, `postalCode`, `countryCode`, `showAddressOnMap`, `soldDate`, `searchStatus`, `propertyType`, `uiPropertyType`, `listingType`, `propertyId`, `listingId`, `dataSourceId`, `marketId`, `yearBuilt`, `dom`, `timeOnRedfin`, `originalTimeOnRedfin`, `timeZone`, `primaryPhotoDisplayLevel`, … (24 more)

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`redfin.py`](redfin.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/redfin-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_properties_for_sale_scraping`, `test_properties_for_rent_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
